newsitem.title: USA: Supertel October occupancy showing gain.
newsitem.headline: Supertel October occupancy showing gain.

text.p: Supertel Hospitality Inc, whose third-quarter occupancy declined to 71.4 percent from 78.9 percent a year ago, said occupancy comparisons in October are much better than September.
President Paul Schulte attributed the turnaround to stepped-up marketing initiatives in Texas that resulted in a strong flow of new contract business.
"Our Wisconsin acquisitions, as expected, were additive to earnings for the third quarter and should continue to be positive next year," Schulte added.
For the third quarter, Supertel reported earnings of $0.26 per share, down from $0.29 a year ago. Revenues gained to $11.4 million from $9.0 million.
During the quarter, Supertel acquired five properties in Wisconsin, comprised of three Super 8 motels and two Comfort Inns. The company also opened its ninth property in Texas.
Year to date, Supertel has added 862 rooms, an increase of 26.2 percent, bringing the total count to 4,157 rooms.
